tuition.label: Tuition
tuition.hint: Enrollment times net tuition, the sticker price less financial aid.

endowmentDraw.label: Endowment draw
endowmentDraw.hint: The set share of the endowment paid out to operations this year, set at Budget & Hiring.

donations.label: Donations
donations.hint: The annual fund from the alumni ledger, plus gifts that arrive as events, often with strings.

researchOverhead.label: Research overhead
researchOverhead.hint: The percentage the college skims off research grants for keeping the lights on.

auxiliaries.label: Auxiliaries
auxiliaries.hint: Housing and dining margins, and ticket revenue once there is somewhere to sell tickets.

facultyPayroll.label: Faculty payroll
facultyPayroll.hint: Every hire's salary; the hiring market opens at Budget & Hiring.

adminPayroll.label: Administration
adminPayroll.hint: The president's office and the administration, which only ever grows.

maintenance.label: Maintenance
maintenance.hint: Per building, scaling with size and age; what is not paid becomes Backlog.

financialAid.label: Financial aid
financialAid.hint: The gap between sticker and net tuition, the primary access lever.

debtService.label: Debt service
debtService.hint: Interest and principal on construction borrowing; the board caps leverage.

programs.label: Programs & student life
programs.hint: Per active program, club and varsity team.

readings.cash: Operating funds: what is in the bank to pay this week's bills.
readings.weekNet: This week's revenue less this week's expenses.
readings.endowment: The invested principal; it earns the year's market return and pays out the draw.
readings.drawRate: The share of the endowment paid out this year; above 5% is an overdraw the board will notice.
readings.marketReturn: What the markets returned on the endowment this fiscal year, accrued weekly.
readings.tuitionDependence: Tuition's share of revenue; above 75% an enrollment miss becomes a crisis.
readings.adminShare: Administration's share of payroll; the DD's guardrail is 25–40%.
readings.backlog: Deferred maintenance across the campus, the debt the buildings carry.
readings.budgetLine: This year's plan for the line, approved the summer before.
readings.actualLine: What the line has actually done so far this year.
readings.yearNet: Revenue less expenses for the year so far.
